title:
This epic is triggered by the {@link ReliabilityApplicationState} upon application load or
by any component or epic that execute the jobs using the action defined in this epic.

The purpose of this epic is to store jobs in local storage, frequently poll for their status,
and display banners anywhere in the application based on their status. When the user closes the application
and returns later, the process will resume for any remaining jobs in local storage.

Banner messages are dynamically resolved using the {@link GlobalWorkflowBannerConfig} configuration.
This configuration defines a mapping between workflow/job identifiers and the corresponding
translation key prefixes used to render banner messages.

Banner text keys should follow the naming convention:
```
Reliability.Banner.<your-key>.<PrimaryText|SecondaryText>.<status>
```
Example translation keys:
- `Reliability.Banner.ExportData.PrimaryText.running`
- `Reliability.Banner.ExportData.SecondaryText.completed`
name: GlobalWorkflowPollerEpic
